IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Law & Justice (originally sponsored by Senators Rivers and Roach)

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a veteran hiring preference for school district security activities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to hiring preferences for veterans; adding a newsection to chapter 28A.400 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.400RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Preference in hiring for school district security activities mustbe given to veterans.
